facts.fact: FAO says a national cocoa-mapping project in Cameroon, funded by the EU, uses satellite data to identify cocoa production zones, and a 16-18 July 2025 Ebolowa workshop trained 50 participants including ministry representatives on SEPAL and Google Earth Engine.
